reason: The send* dispatchers (auth-email-service.ts, organization-email-service.ts, email-manager.ts) follow it, but the two listed exempt entries are exported helpers in email-manager.ts:62/67 (shouldSkipAttendeeEmailWithSettings is imported and unit-tested by email-manager.test.ts), neither a definition nor the aggregator, so R1 counts them as legit: 0 of 2 counted.
